summary: Arauco filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Chilean Material Fact (Hecho Esencial) disclosing execution of an Equity Support Agreement with parent Empresas Copec S.A. after an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting approved it September 10, 2026; the agreement was signed September 11 and reported September 14. The capital contribution is a related-party equity commitment under Article 147 of Chile's Corporations Law, which is the local equivalent of a US parent backstop or capital infusion. No price, stake, premium or close date is stated; economic effects are described as positive but unquantified. Watch for terms and dilution or control implications, plus minority-shareholder governance risk.
